record.reason: Formalizes structured pruning as axis-aligned projection and model folding as low-rank projection via weight clustering, proving folding's smaller reconstruction error within rank distance one and validating on 1000+ checkpoints of ResNet/ViT/CLIP plus small 60M/130M LLaMA models; compression theory relevant to inference, but LLM evidence is limited to tiny models and no latency is measured.
record.title: Cut Less, Fold More: Model Compression through the Lens of Projection Geometry
